nodes.label: Raw-Body Upload (No Multipart)
nodes.rationale: No new Python dependencies allowed, in particular no python-multipart, so upload endpoints take a raw body.

nodes.label: Explicit docker stop on STOP (Decision 3)
nodes.rationale: Signal forwarding alone is not trusted to kill the container, so stop() always issues docker stop <name> too.

nodes.label: Foreground docker run (no -d)
nodes.rationale: Spawned via subprocess.Popen in the foreground (--rm --network host --gpus all) so it has the same terminate/exit lifecycle as agent_runner.py, letting AgentRun share code.

nodes.label: Pull then re-tag as submission-*
nodes.rationale: Pulled image indistinguishable from built one, so docker-list, AgentRun and UI need zero changes.

nodes.label: AgentRun.run(kind='script'|'docker')
nodes.rationale: Rejected parallel DockerAgentRun: kinds differ only in Popen argv; duplication means two places to fix bugs.

nodes.label: Explicit docker stop on STOP
nodes.rationale: Not betting a flying drone on the CLI forwarding signals to the container.

nodes.label: advance()-Based Autonomous/Manual Dispatch
nodes.rationale: Loop dispatches on whether advance() yields a target, never on mission state: target -> position setpoint, None -> joystick velocity. Exactly one setpoint per tick.

nodes.label: Record Commands Bypass SetpointLoop (R2)
nodes.rationale: Recording touches no MAVLink; a blocking HTTP call on the 20 Hz setpoint thread would gap the stream and drop PX4 out of OFFBOARD.

nodes.label: Mission Speed Clamp (MPC_XY_VEL_MAX=3)
nodes.rationale: PX4 default 12 m/s vs the pad's 2 m/s; unclamped FLY would send the aircraft six times faster than anything the operator has seen.

nodes.label: Invariant: Setpoint Stream Never Gaps
nodes.rationale: Zeros are a valid hover setpoint; any gap drops PX4 out of OFFBOARD. Load-bearing invariant carried into the map-waypoints plan.

nodes.label: FIX_GROUND_FLIP = False
nodes.rationale: The builder authors the plane flat in a Z-up stage, so fix_ground_plane() would break a correct plane; only for the hand-built Y-up Script-Editor path.

nodes.label: ufw firewall ports 8080/8090/8091
nodes.rationale: ufw drops silently (browser timeout); scope to LAN because there is no authentication.

nodes.label: Author Z-Up Before Any Content
nodes.rationale: Authoring anchors into a Y-up stage and letting Isaac flip it afterwards rotates tiles, mesh and ground plane 90 degrees; this is the failure the rewrite exists to prevent.

nodes.label: SET_POSITION_TARGET_GLOBAL_INT (frame 6, mask 2552)
nodes.rationale: PX4 projects lat/lon to local NED itself, so no projection code is owned here.

nodes.label: Plan: Web Joystick to PX4 OFFBOARD Velocity Control
nodes.norm_label: plan: web joystick to px4 offboard velocity control
nodes.rationale: Four-command pad (climb/descend/forward/backward) flying real PX4 OFFBOARD body-frame velocity setpoints at 20 Hz with the Isaac MJPEG feed embedded; complete, flown 2026-07-31.

nodes.label: Plan: Satellite Map + Autonomous Waypoint Missions
nodes.norm_label: plan: satellite map + autonomous waypoint missions
nodes.rationale: Waypoint routes fly through the same OFFBOARD stream as manual input so touching the pad takes over in ~0.65 s with no mode switch; complete, flown 2026-07-31.

nodes.label: Setpoint continuity invariant (never stop the stream)
nodes.norm_label: setpoint continuity invariant (never stop the stream)
nodes.rationale: Stopping the stream drops OFFBOARD; PX4 rejects OFFBOARD entry unless setpoints already stream >2 Hz.

nodes.label: advance() return contract as loop dispatch rule
nodes.norm_label: advance() return contract as loop dispatch rule
nodes.rationale: Dispatch on whether advance() yields a target, not on RUNNING, so DONE keeps holding last waypoint (position hold resists wind, zero-velocity drifts).

nodes.label: FLY gating (home_valid, OFFBOARD, position)
nodes.rationale: Missing home altitude and non-OFFBOARD setpoints both fail silently inside PX4.

nodes.label: Mission speed clamp MPC_XY_VEL_MAX = 3 m/s
nodes.rationale: PX4 default 12 m/s is 6x the pad speed; clamp keeps FLY feeling like the same aircraft.

nodes.label: Rejected: PX4 AUTO.MISSION upload
nodes.rationale: Takeover would need a mode switch and OFFBOARD re-warmup at the worst moment; one shared OFFBOARD stream makes takeover a packet-content change.

nodes.label: R2: record proxy runs on web thread, not setpoint queue
nodes.norm_label: r2: record proxy runs on web thread, not setpoint queue
nodes.rationale: Kit HTTP can block hundreds of ms; a setpoint gap drops OFFBOARD, so RECORD must never enter submit().

nodes.label: Never Nest _telem_lock and Mission._lock
nodes.rationale: Setpoint thread touches both every tick; each call site takes one, releases, then the other, so no lock cycle/deadlock.

nodes.label: RC Mode 2 Stick Layout
nodes.rationale: Matches a real RC transmitter: left stick x->yaw, y->thrust; right stick x->roll, y->pitch.

nodes.label: Stick Wire Message {type: stick}
nodes.rationale: Client sends raw normalized DOM offsets (right/down positive) and never applies flight sign conventions; server flips (thrust=-y, pitch=-y), applies 0.05 deadzone and [-1,1] clamp.

nodes.label: Up-Positive Convention, Single NED Flip
nodes.rationale: up is positive everywhere in competition/ and examples; the NED sign flip happens exactly once in agent_control.py and OffboardLink.send_velocity_world.

nodes.label: FLY Gating that Names the Blocker
nodes.norm_label: fly gating that names the blocker
nodes.rationale: Two preconditions (home altitude, OFFBOARD mode) fail SILENTLY inside PX4, so the disabled button's tooltip names the reason.

nodes.label: BODY_NED velocity setpoint (type_mask 1479, yaw_rate)
nodes.rationale: BODY_NED rotates by yaw only and passes vz as world-down: forward tracks nose, up stays up.

nodes.label: COM_RCL_EXCEPT=4 (offboard RC-loss exception)
nodes.rationale: No RC in SITL; default NAV_RCL_ACT would trigger Return mid-demo.

nodes.label: udpin:0.0.0.0:14540, not udpout
nodes.rationale: PX4 binds 14580 and sends to 14540, so companion must bind; the pipeline-streaming plan's udpout would never receive a heartbeat.

nodes.rationale: An edge not a level: polling held() at 20 Hz could miss a press-release inside one tick. Only presses pause; if releases did, RESUME could never take.

nodes.rationale: Proves an external script can fly through the unmodified web /ws protocol; validated against a mock, not yet flown on real SITL.

nodes.rationale: PX4 default 12 m/s is six times the pad speed; 3 m/s keeps FLY feeling like the same aircraft.

nodes.label: Shared OFFBOARD setpoint stream
nodes.rationale: Manual and autonomous feed one stream so takeover is instant with no mode switch; routes are flown as OFFBOARD position setpoints, not AUTO.MISSION, at the cost of QGC not showing the route.

nodes.label: flight(left_x, left_y, right_x, right_y) primitive
nodes.rationale: Stateless and watchdogged (decays to hover after ~0.5s), body frame, positive-up thrust, each axis in [-1,1].

nodes.label: flight() validation spike (15-line guidance loop)
nodes.rationale: Reached a 47 m target within 2 m on live SITL; caught a one-message-per-tick MAVLink drain starvation bug.

nodes.label: Detector / Detection (detection.py)
nodes.rationale: One model per instance; ultralytics-style .pt checkpoint; falls back to CPU if no GPU.

nodes.label: D8 hybrid statefulness split on hazard
nodes.norm_label: d8 hybrid statefulness split on hazard
nodes.rationale: Route is stateful (pre-declared intention); Velocity is stateless and watchdogged (stuck velocity is a hazard).

nodes.label: Cartesian axes, not polar (bearing, push)
nodes.rationale: Scripts hold direction vectors, not angles; polar forced atan2/sin/cos round-trips, found as pure overhead in the spike.

nodes.label: Four commands collapsed to flight() (commit 7eede71)
nodes.rationale: Velocity/VelocityWorld/Goto/Hold removed as trivially rebuildable on flight(); Route and Inspect kept for tick-rate smoothness and standoff solving.

nodes.label: Input watchdog (dead-man's switch)
nodes.rationale: A stuck manual key is a hazard, so manual input decays to hover within ~0.5s of losing keepalives; routes are exempt because unattended completion is correct.

nodes.label: streaming/commander.py (V2b climb-and-search FSM)
nodes.rationale: FSM NORMAL -> SEARCH -> GIVE-UP with pipeline-side safety bounds (bounded climb rate, hard ceiling) independent of PX4.

nodes.label: streaming/dsmac_live.py (Layer 1: DSMAC to streaming)
nodes.rationale: Needs ortho-tile pre-fetch around start lat/lon and a worker thread so GPU matching does not stall the VISION_POSITION_ESTIMATE heartbeat.

nodes.label: streaming/ekf2_ev_params.params (EKF2 external-vision params)
nodes.rationale: EKF2_EV_CTRL=15, EKF2_HGT_REF=3 (vision height), EKF2_GPS_CTRL=0 so EKF2 cannot fall back to simulated GPS and mask a broken vision feed.

nodes.label: enu_to_ned() / yaw_enu_to_ned()
nodes.rationale: The repo's estimators work in ENU throughout; PX4 expects NED, so conversion happens only at this one boundary.

nodes.label: SetpointSender (planned V2a)
nodes.rationale: Planned sibling of VisionPositionSender: target lat/lon -> local ENU -> NED as SET_POSITION_TARGET_LOCAL_NED every loop (>2 Hz or PX4 drops OFFBOARD).

nodes.label: VisionPositionSender
nodes.rationale: roll/pitch sent as 0.0 because EKF2_EV_CTRL fuses only position + yaw; reset_counter increments only on explicit reset() to tell EKF a jump is expected.

nodes.label: Roadmap: After v1 Streaming Lands
nodes.rationale: Sequenced by dependency and risk: initial-state hardening and the validation gate need no streaming code and run in parallel with v1; V2b climb-and-search is built only if the DSMAC altitude validation passes.

nodes.label: Validation Gate: DSMAC Accept-Rate vs Altitude (Exp10)
nodes.norm_label: validation gate: dsmac accept-rate vs altitude (exp10)
nodes.rationale: Cheap batch check that de-risks V2b: if accept-rate does not rise with altitude, repeated-failure response becomes loiter/alert, not climb.

nodes.label: Reuse, don't fork (import pipeline.py functions unchanged)
nodes.norm_label: reuse, don't fork (import pipeline.py functions unchanged)

nodes.label: PX4 / Isaac Sim lockstep
nodes.rationale: Physics clock slows when rendering falls behind, so 'tilts but barely moves' is usually low sim rate, not a fault; CPU starvation shows as poll timeouts.

nodes.label: PX4 SITL never sent heartbeat (2026-08-07)
nodes.rationale: Transport mismatch (udpin vs PX4 TCP connect) plus lockstep disabled; neither raised an exception.

nodes.label: D3 free-running real-time sim (not lockstep)
nodes.rationale: Makes algorithm speed self-penalising via physics with no scoring rule; runs are not bit-reproducible, accepted.

nodes.label: D1/D2 Jetson edge box, FC co-located with Isaac
nodes.norm_label: d1/d2 jetson edge box, fc co-located with isaac
nodes.rationale: Puts the deadline-bearing loop and the network hop on opposite sides of the flight controller.

nodes.label: D4 setpoint-level API (no attitude/rate/motors)
nodes.rationale: A late velocity setpoint stays physically valid, so there is no starvation failure mode; exposing rate control would move the hard deadline across the network.

nodes.label: Command confirmation deadline in sim time
nodes.norm_label: command confirmation deadline in sim time
nodes.rationale: PX4 only advances when Isaac does; a wall-clock deadline would falsely report good commands as refused when sim rate is low.

nodes.label: PX4MavlinkBackendConfig explicit SITL values (tcpin, localhost, lockstep)
nodes.norm_label: px4mavlinkbackendconfig explicit sitl values (tcpin, localhost, lockstep)
nodes.rationale: Stating SITL-correct values instead of reverting the deliberate HITL patch keeps the script independent of Pegasus's current defaults.

nodes.label: flight(left_x, left_y, right_x, right_y)
nodes.rationale: Cartesian body-frame normalized sticks, 5 m/s full deflection; replaces Velocity/VelocityWorld/Goto/Hold.

nodes.label: Unresolved: Route vs ATE score
nodes.rationale: Organizer-side Route gives everyone max ATE for free; leading resolution is cut Route, keep Inspect, use geofence/track-distance ATE trigger.

nodes.label: flight_waypoint_test.py spike validation
nodes.rationale: 47 m offset reached within 2 m with zero yaw; found drain-one-message-per-tick starvation bug.

nodes.label: --descriptive mode (joystick-server-descriptive.py on :8091)
nodes.rationale: Labelled panels plus a sim ground-truth marker fed from /tmp/drone_truth.json; Isaac is shared so both servers can run at once.

nodes.label: sim/run-website.sh (idempotent launcher)
nodes.rationale: Checks what is running and starts only what is missing, so it is safe to rerun after a crash.

nodes.label: Ground-truth map marker and GT err readout
nodes.norm_label: ground-truth map marker and gt err readout

nodes.label: stop-website skill
nodes.rationale: Matches only this repo's process signatures so an unrelated Isaac/SITL on the box keeps running; SIGTERM then SIGKILL after ~10s.

nodes.label: Route(waypoints, alt, speed)
nodes.rationale: Runs entirely on the simulator host at FC rate, cleaner than a hand-rolled flight() loop at ~20 Hz.

nodes.label: Open question: Route vs ATE
nodes.rationale: Route flies identically for every team, so ATE stops differentiating; leading candidate is cutting Route and switching the ATE trigger to a geofence check. Unresolved.

nodes.label: Waypoint mission state machine (IDLE/RUNNING/PAUSED/DONE)
nodes.rationale: Mission state lives server-side so a closed browser does not stop a route; leaving OFFBOARD auto-pauses; releasing the pad does not resume to avoid silently re-engaging autonomy.

nodes.label: D10 control-style freedom and follow_route asymmetry
nodes.norm_label: d10 control-style freedom and follow_route asymmetry
nodes.rationale: follow_route runs closed-loop on the host while set_velocity crosses the wire; the asymmetry must be documented and every mode tuned equally.

nodes.label: Perception, not airmanship (competition premise)
nodes.rationale: Nobody should write PID loops; the winning behaviour is sweep on nadir, spot, divert and read on oblique.

nodes.label: FLY button gates (link, position, home_valid, OFFBOARD, waypoints)
nodes.norm_label: fly button gates (link, position, home_valid, offboard, waypoints)
nodes.rationale: PX4 silently discards position setpoints without valid home or outside OFFBOARD, so the button explains itself instead of being a dead control.

nodes.label: Legibility and coverage budget (arena/camera physics)
nodes.rationale: Nadir must cover the arena but be unable to read text, so the two-phase strategy is optimal; at 117 m / 20 m/s the sweep takes ~23.7 min.

nodes.label: Callback timing budgets (on_frame 200 ms, on_tick 50 ms)
nodes.norm_label: callback timing budgets (on_frame 200 ms, on_tick 50 ms)

nodes.label: Inspect(lat, lon)
nodes.rationale: Harness solves standoff distance, altitude and heading so teams do not all rewrite the same triangle.

nodes.label: D5 inversion of control (harness owns the loop)
nodes.norm_label: d5 inversion of control (harness owns the loop)
nodes.rationale: Organiser controls tick timing and timeouts; a hung submission costs one tick; on_frame/on_tick split gives fast/slow decomposition for free.

nodes.label: D6 two fixed cameras (nadir search / oblique inspect)
nodes.norm_label: d6 two fixed cameras (nadir search / oblique inspect)
nodes.rationale: Camera selection replaces variable zoom; no gimbal couples gaze to flight, making attitude the aim.

nodes.label: MahonyState (incremental Mahony AHRS)
nodes.rationale: Extracted from compute_ahrs_attitude's per-tick loop so the batch and streaming paths share one implementation, identical by construction. Cold start must be seeded from heading, not np.eye(3): identity is a 180-degree roll singularity for the gravity correction.

nodes.label: pipeline-streaming.py (streaming estimator + MAVLink loop)
nodes.rationale: v1 scope: LK flow-odom only, baro-derived depth (no rangefinder), no GT; works in local ENU from its own start point. Default mavlink udpout:14540 later found wrong (must be udpin).

nodes.label: Plan: Streaming VIO Pipeline to PX4/QGC
nodes.norm_label: plan: streaming vio pipeline to px4/qgc
nodes.rationale: SUPERSEDED 2026-08-07 by 2026-08-07-vio-gps-denied.md: the goal is unchanged but it predates the web UI, sim/-driven launch and sim/sites.py; its MAVLink port collides with joystick-server.py's bind on 14540 and its QGC param-editor procedures no longer apply. Retained for the design rationale in Tasks 1-4.

nodes.label: Initial-State Hardening (start_alt/yaw, GPS origin, Mahony seed)
nodes.norm_label: initial-state hardening (start_alt/yaw, gps origin, mahony seed)
nodes.rationale: Needed for v1 quality and all commanding: SET_GPS_GLOBAL_ORIGIN once at startup gives PX4 an absolute anchor while GPS is off.

nodes.label: Use udpin, not udpout, for PX4 link (14540)
nodes.norm_label: use udpin, not udpout, for px4 link (14540)
nodes.rationale: PX4 binds 14580 and sends TO 14540, so udpout would silently never receive a heartbeat.

nodes.label: FREEZE SIM button and hil-stream readout
nodes.norm_label: freeze sim button and hil-stream readout

nodes.label: /hil/freeze, /hil/thaw, /hil/status endpoints
nodes.rationale: Communicate via logs/hil_tap.ctl and hil_tap.status.json; status mtime >3s old reports tap down, distinguishing dead tap from frozen.

nodes.label: sim/hil_tap.py (HIL MAVLink MITM freeze tap)
nodes.rationale: Sits on :4560 forwarding to Isaac on :4561 (SIM_TCP_BASEPORT); withholding thrust halts Isaac's physics within a frame, making lockstep visible.

nodes.label: Drone SITL & flight() brief deck (artifact variant)
nodes.norm_label: drone sitl & flight() brief deck (artifact variant)
nodes.rationale: Same deck with head/body tags stripped and fonts via @import for artifact publishing.

nodes.label: --max-freeze auto-thaw guard (20 s)
nodes.rationale: A freeze over ~30 s makes PX4's simulator_mavlink give up for good and orphan past stop-website.

nodes.label: handle_request()
nodes.rationale: Kept a pure function of (method, path, session, queue) so it is testable without binding a socket; BaseHTTPRequestHandler is a thin shell.

nodes.label: RecorderSession
nodes.rationale: Pure state machine with every Kit coupling injected as a callable so the bulk of the feature is testable without Isaac Sim.

nodes.label: HTTP Thread Enqueues, Main Thread Execs (R1)
nodes.norm_label: http thread enqueues, main thread execs (r1)
nodes.rationale: Kit work must run on the main thread; the HTTP thread only validates and enqueues, a Kit update callback executes.

nodes.label: Recorder Free-Space Gate
nodes.rationale: Runs measure 22-30 GB and the disk sat at 90% full; a run that fills the disk mid-way corrupts its own dataset and destabilises the sim and PX4, so free space blocks start rather than warns.

nodes.label: Single MAVLink-owner setpoint thread + command queue
nodes.norm_label: single mavlink-owner setpoint thread + command queue
nodes.rationale: pymavlink connections are not thread-safe; web layer only mutates shared state, one-shot commands drained by the setpoint thread.

nodes.label: R1: HTTP thread enqueues, Kit main thread executes
nodes.norm_label: r1: http thread enqueues, kit main thread executes
nodes.rationale: Kit does not support physics callbacks/USD/replicator from non-main threads; reuses joystick-server's submit/queue discipline.

nodes.label: R4: recorder exec'd unmodified into kept namespace
nodes.norm_label: r4: recorder exec'd unmodified into kept namespace

nodes.label: R5: RECORD records, does not arm (TAKEOFF_ALT_M=0)
nodes.norm_label: r5: record records, does not arm (takeoff_alt_m=0)
nodes.rationale: The invisible takeoff gate produced the zero-byte run.

nodes.label: R6: free-space gate (<50G disabled, <100G warn)
nodes.rationale: ~7 runs of disk left; a disk filling mid-flight corrupts the run and destabilises sim and PX4.

nodes.label: D9 image delivery: one camera, search + lossless ROI tiers
nodes.norm_label: d9 image delivery: one camera, search + lossless roi tiers
nodes.rationale: The 10 ms concern is bandwidth, not clock sync; lossy compression destroys OCR detail, so reading uses lossless full-res crops.

nodes.label: Mission pause as edge (axis pressed), not level
nodes.norm_label: mission pause as edge (axis pressed), not level
nodes.rationale: Polling held() at 20 Hz misses sub-50 ms presses and would auto-resume on release; a WS message cannot be missed.

nodes.label: AD5: first manual input kills agent, no resume
nodes.norm_label: ad5: first manual input kills agent, no resume
